rene.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / precise pose correction.
Edit target: existing Rene sprite sheet. Keep the same older commentator, moustache, silver hair, blue cardigan, shirt, tie, headset, broad flat hand-drawn shapes and limited colors.
PRIMARY CORRECTION: Rene must look STRAIGHT DOWN BELOW HIS OWN CHEST toward the bottom center of EACH cell. No leftward gaze. Turn both shoulders square to the camera, head almost frontal in yaw (0 to 5 degrees), then tilt the head DOWN about 35 degrees. Nose centered between two equally visible ears, bridge of glasses symmetrical, pupils lowered, chin tucked toward sternum. Viewer sees the upper surface of his silver hair. His field of attention lies vertically below him, not to screen left or right. Keep eyes readable under eyebrows. Both cheeks visible equally, no profile and no three-quarter turn.
He sits above an arena, leaning over a horizontal dark navy railing and looking down at it like an old hockey analyst. Not looking at the player/camera. Not looking down-left. Do not simply move pupils while retaining left-turned head.
FORMAT invariant: EXACT 4 columns by 2 rows, 8 equally sized cells. Keep natural restrained human proportions, the same character design, dark #091423 background. Each bust fully contained in its cell, head/torso centered, same rail baseline. Col1 quietly watching down; col2 explaining with hand but still head down center; col3 adjusting glasses with face down center; col4 worried with hand on rail, still head down center. Top row mouths closed; bottom row matching poses mouths open. Do not include side-looking poses in this atlas; those are for future animation.
Palette: navy outlines, flat pastel blues, silver masses, three warm skin tones, restrained yellow pencil. No gradients, photographic texture, tiny wrinkles, hair strands, dithering, labels, text, grid, extra people. Strong economical drawn planes and clean shapes suitable for 192x128 pixel display per cell.

gerard.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / pose correction.
Edit target: Gerard 4x2 portrait atlas. Preserve his identity, age, receding dark hair, salt-and-pepper beard, headset, pastel blue Hawaiian shirt with yellow lemons, red flowers and green leaves, navy undershirt and railing. Preserve broad drawn ink shapes and limited flat colors.
Change head and torso orientation in ALL eight cells: shoulders parallel to image plane, head almost FRONTAL (0-5 degrees yaw), chin tucked down, gaze directed STRAIGHT BELOW his own chest to bottom center of EACH cell. Both ears and cheeks equally visible. Nose centered. Head tilted DOWN 30 degrees, upper forehead/hair visible, eyes lowered, NOT looking at camera. More centered and less sideways than source. He is above the playing field, leaning forward over railing, watching the match directly underneath him. No sideways or three-quarter left/right poses now; future lateral animations will be separate. Natural, restrained slightly gruff man, no heroic grin.
Exact 4 columns by 2 rows, evenly sized cells, head and torso centered in each cell, rail aligned, entire bust including hands contained. Col1 quietly watching below, col2 explaining enthusiastically with one open hand while looking below, col3 listening with hand on headset and gaze down center, col4 tense leaning over rail with down-centered head. Top row mouths closed, bottom row corresponding identical poses mouths open for speaking.
No new items, background, text or watermark. Solid #091423 backdrop. Simplify drawing into flat color masses, 3 skin tones, blue 2-3 tones, navy outlines, no photo detail, no gradients, no tiny hair/wrinkles, no dithering. Designed to read well at 192x128 per cell. Keep facial features recognizable and no oversized comic expressions.

Creature must occupy most of the picture, large readable silhouette, facing right, the beacon secondary. Dark blue tropical water, tiny suggestion of coral or rocks only. Slightly weird, funny and earthy, no polished cute mascot.

Raw and playful, few decisive pixels, no dither carpet.
